Make the numbers yours

Changes calculations only
Known monthly subtotal
Listed upfront subtotal

Monthly: supplied rent + known amenity charges. Upfront: one month of supplied rent + known deposit + application fees. One application per leaseholder; deposit held constant.

RENTER EDGE · RESEARCH PROTOTYPE

BEHIND THE REPORT

A clearer view of a complicated decision.

Renter Edge turns listing claims into a traceable report: what the supplied evidence supports, what conflicts, and what still needs a question.

  1. Research in Codex. Parallel first, then TinyFish and Exa as needed.
  2. Review the evidence. Keep source dates, property identity and uncertainty visible.
  3. Explore the report here. Read findings, calculate known costs and prepare your questions.

The optional Analyze listing feature uses server-side Parallel extraction and OpenAI analysis when configured. Saved reports do not refresh automatically. Its three built-in reports use real marketplace snapshots with dated sources; availability is not independently confirmed. Imported reports stay in browser memory; nothing is uploaded or saved after refresh.
